jobs.title: AI Engineer, Computer Vision
jobs.description_text: About the Team Localization is where the map meets the moment. Our localization team builds the living geospatial world model and the centimeter-level Visual Positioning System (VPS) that lets people and robots know exactly where they are, from any camera, almost anywhere on Earth. That system is learned, not hand-built. Our localization stack has moved from classical geometry to visual models trained on billions of posed images — models that have to be accurate to the centimeter, robust to lighting and seasons and clutter, and fast enough to run in production for every query. This team sits at the junction of research and production: we take what works in a paper, make it work on our data, and make it work for customers. About the Role We're hiring an AI Engineer, Computer Vision, to contribute to the deep learning models at the heart of our localization system. Working alongside experienced researchers and engineers, you'll help train and iterate on the visual models — feature extractors, matchers, pose regressors, and retrieval models — that turn a single image into a precise position in the world. This is a full-loop environment. You'll get exposure to the entire pipeline: the data the model learns on, training, evaluation, and the service that runs it in production. You'll be surrounded by people who care deeply about correctness — where a loss curve going down is not the same as a system getting better — and you'll grow into that rigor quickly. jobs.title: Member of the Operations Staff, Business Development
jobs.description_text: Output has built a biological reasoning model that understands biology at the scale and complexity life actually operates. Our model independently learned the principles of molecular interactions, opening up drug treatments that were previously impossible. We're already generating therapies that traditional approaches cannot reach. The hardest problems in both AI and biology are being solved here, and there is room for you to help bring it to the world. Output is currently in stealth, operated by a team of repeat founders and biotech veterans with multiple exits in AI x Bio, and backed by top-tier VCs including Y Combinator. You will own the groundwork behind every partnership Output pursues — finding the right partners, understanding what each would want, and getting us to the table prepared. You'll work closely with our founders — among them a former large-pharma VP of Business Development — bringing them in at the right moment. It's a chance to build the partnering engine from the ground up, alongside people who have done this at scale. jobs.title: Technician, Quality Control (Fragrance)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Osmo's QC function is being built from the ground up, and this seat is where day-to-day quality judgment lives. You'll run testing and sampling on raw materials coming in and finished fragrance going out, using real fragrance-industry judgment that automated testing alone can't provide. You'll have the standing to make real-time accept/reject calls independently, and the experience to step in and cover QC decisions when the QC Manager is out. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - Judge incoming raw material results from automated testing, deciding when an out-of-spec reading is a real defect versus normal variation in a natural material - Apply trained olfactive judgment to evaluate raw materials and finished goods using sensory skill the equipment can't replicate - Run triangulation testing on outgoing product to confirm it matches prior batches before it reaches a customer - Make accept/reject calls in real time, multiple times a day, escalating only genuinely ambiguous cases to the QC Manager - Step in and cover QC sign-off when the QC Manager is unavailable, keeping finished-goods flow moving rather than stalling - Maintain and run lab instrumentation (GC/MS, photosampler, flash point testing, colorimeters), including calibration checks and upkeep - Maintain audit-ready lab records: test logs, certificates of analysis, and equipment records - Mentor QC Tech (L2) staff on fragrance-specific testing and olfactive judgment - Partner across the floor with Purchasing, Warehouse, Sh

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Osmo is seeking an experienced regulatory professional to own the interpretation and implementation of regulatory requirements for fragrance ingredients and fragrance oils across global markets. This role operates with significant independence, resolving complex and novel compliance questions and advising cross-functional teams on regulatory risk before it becomes a blocker. jobs.title: Manufacturing Readiness Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Osmo's customer programs don't end at signature — they succeed or fail in the handoff from creative work to real manufacturing. This role owns that handoff: the point where a customer's project moves from onboarding into production, fulfillment, and deployment, and where dropped threads become missed shipments. You'll be the primary operational point of contact for customers after launch, and the person who keeps manufacturing, procurement, product development, quality, and delivery teams moving in the same direction. This is a role for someone who's tenacious about closing gaps before they become customer-facing problems, curious enough to actually understand how fragrance gets made rather than just tracking a spreadsheet of it, and kind in how they hold internal teams accountable to the commitments made to customers. jobs.title: Head of AI
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Osmo is building the first computer that can smell. Olfactory Intelligence (OI) is the model suite behind that: it predicts how a molecule or a mixture will smell, generates new formulas from a creative brief, and now powers commercial products for some of the largest consumer goods companies in the world. It runs on 5.4M+ human sniff annotations, 100M+ mass spectral readings, and a molecule library in the billions, data no one else has. We are hiring a Head of Applied AI to own the team that builds these models. You will lead the ML engineers and research scientists, set the roadmap and the quality bar, and own the path from research notebook to production API. You will report to the CTO and work daily with Software Platform, Product Engineering, Chemistry, Sensory Science, and the perfumers and evaluators who are the ground truth for every prediction. This is a hands-on leadership seat at a company of roughly 100 people. You will read the code, run experiments, and be held to hard contractual accuracy gates with enterprise partners. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Osmo is seeking a highly meticulous and olfactively acute individual to join our team as Contract Sensory Panelist (Fragrance). This is a specialized, part-time contract role dedicated exclusively to generating high-quality sensory data that fuels our Olfactory Intelligence models. It's work that rewards genuine curiosity about scent and the tenacity to stay sharp through long, repetitive evaluation sessions. You'll use your superior sense of smell to characterize the behavior, performance, and stability of fragrance compounds and formulas, directly contributing to the digitization of scent. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Periodic Labs is building an AI that can simulate science and verify its own predictions — training on the full scientific method. Central to that mission is a high-throughput experimental materials science lab that handles hazardous chemistries, high-pressure and high-temperature processes, air-sensitive synthesis, toxic gas exposure risks, and an expanding suite of thin-film deposition tools including PVD, PLD and the complexity of what we run overnight and autonomously is increasing every month. We believe EHS is integral to this ambition, not a compliance function bolted on after the fact, but a core design discipline that makes autonomous science possible. This EHS leadership role will build our safety architecture, defining permitting strategy, designing life safety systems, conducting process hazard analyses, and ultimately training our AI to reason about risk during experimental planning and execution. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Lead the site EH&S team through a hands-on approach to problem solving and operational support while promoting a strong safety and environmental culture. Ensure compliance with applicable EH&S regulations and standards, develop and improve programs aligned with company goals, and actively partner with lab and operations teams on day-to-day safety challenges. We’re building an autonomous lab to speed up materials discovery, and we need someone who loves making instruments, robots, and data systems run together smoothly. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Collaborate with bench scientists to translate experiments and lab workflows into clear integration specs and data models. - Work with integrators to design and build automated workcells for materials R&D. - Build and maintain services that connect instruments and robots to lab information systems. - Develop instrument drivers that automate lab workflows by generating command sequences and invoking vendor API/SDK methods. - Collaborate with AI and data scientists to tightly integrate the autonomous lab with AI models for analysis and planning of experiments. You will commission, qualify, and maintain R&D thin-film deposition systems, including but not limited to PVD, CVD, and ALD, working closely with vendors to assemble, install, and bring tools online, and troubleshoot complex vacuum and process-hardware issues at the equipment level. In this role, you will collaborate daily with internal teams spanning AI/ML, simulation, process engineering, and physics/chemistry to stand up scalable lab infrastructure for high-value problems. jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description_text: About the Role We are hiring our first in-house Controller to own the integrity and day-to-day operation of Periodic Labs’ accounting function. You will serve as the primary internal owner of accounting, financial reporting, controls, audit readiness, and compliance. This is a hands-on builder role. You will have the opportunity to not only review and conduct accounting analysis, but also shape the overall accounting function at Periodic Labs. jobs.description_text: Summary We’re looking for an experienced engineer to own the navigation and positioning stack for Rivet’s head-worn and body-worn systems. You will be responsible for turning inertial and GNSS sensor data into a robust, continuous estimate of position and orientation across challenging real-world environments. This includes sensor calibration and characterization, inertial navigation, GNSS integration, and the estimation algorithms that bring these inputs together. You will work closely with our perception team to define how navigation and visual tracking complement one another and provide a stable experience to downstream systems. This is a highly hands-on role spanning algorithms, embedded software, hardware integration, laboratory testing, and field validation.
